gaps.explanation: No proprietary schedule; the proprietary funds statement p16 prints seven enterprise columns (Golf, Sanitation, Solid Waste Disposal Facility, Sanitary Sewer, Water, Storm Water, Airport; Total Enterprise Funds and the internal service column not used). JSON receipts = Sales 31,377,365 + Miscellaneous 808,585 + Intergovernmental 4,361,734 + Investment earnings/(loss) (176,522) + Gains on disposal 21,646 = 36,392,808. Added the same rows per column. Sales: 1,249,485 + 5,372,188 + 1,682,279 + 8,788,302 + 10,586,727 + 418,158 + 3,280,226 = 31,377,365; Miscellaneous: 445,775 + 17,827 + 214,714 + 130,269 = 808,585; Intergovernmental: 40,537 + 4,321,197 = 4,361,734; Investment earnings: 4,366 - 207,108 + 13,942 + 8,312 + 1,748 + 2,218 = (176,522); Gains: Golf 21,646. Sum = 36,392,808 = statement total. Capital contributions (JSON business_type other_financing 1,485,957) are listed under transfers_net as other financing.
